findings.highlight: I even changed my way of life because of it
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの人生変えといて何言ってるのこのコたちって
findings.explanation: Setsuna's old friends changed her life and then acted as though the rupture were nothing. The translation makes Setsuna the agent who changed her own way of life, weakening the accusation at the center of her anecdote.
findings.japanese:
「わたしも最初『何それ？』って思ったよ。
もう六年以上も、ずっと心から離れることはなかったのに。
…わたしの人生変えといて何言ってるのこのコたちって」
findings.todokanai: "At first, I was like, 'What the heck?' I've been holding on to it for more than six years. …I even changed my way of life because of it, so what is wrong with them?"

findings.highlight: I've tried my best to make up with them
findings.evidenceJa: 仲直りしようと頑張ったかって聞かれると、ちょっと弱いけどね
findings.explanation: Setsuna admits her case is weak if asked whether she worked to reconcile. The English states the opposite—that she tried her best—and attributes failure to insufficient strength, reversing her accountability.
findings.japanese:
「ここまで…六年かかった。本当に長かった。
…その間、仲直りしようと頑張ったかって聞かれると、
ちょっと弱いけどね」
findings.todokanai: "It's been six years since then. It's been a really long time. …I've tried my best to make up with them within that period, but I wasn't strong enough for that."

findings.highlight: heavily sympathizing with what happened to her
findings.evidenceJa: 自分と重ね合わせてるのかな
findings.explanation: Setsuna thinks Takeya and Io may be overlaying their own experiences onto Koharu, as she is. Generic sympathy erases the self-projection that links their intervention to their own history and guilt.
findings.japanese:
「二人とも、わたしと同じで、
自分と重ね合わせてるのかなって思ったんだけど…」
findings.todokanai: "I thought those two were heavily sympathizing with what happened to her, much like I was…"

findings.highlight: Koharu involved herself to protect me
findings.evidenceJa: 小春は、俺を庇おうとして巻き込まれたんだ
findings.explanation: Haruki says Koharu was dragged into the consequences while trying to protect him. The translation makes her actively involve herself, shifting culpability toward Koharu in the very sentence where Haruki assumes it.
findings.japanese:
「全部、俺が引き起こしたことなんだ。
彼女…小春は、俺を庇おうとして巻き込まれたんだ」
findings.todokanai: "Everything happened because of me. She… Koharu involved herself to protect me."

findings.highlight: Setsuna's been running away from her own situation as well
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜からして自分のこと棚に上げてる
findings.explanation: Haruki notes that Setsuna knowingly sets her own case aside while accusing him. The English says she is running away from her situation and condemns him because she knows the feeling, replacing both the rhetorical maneuver and her stated motive.
findings.japanese:
だって、雪菜からして自分のこと棚に上げてる。
そのことを十分わかってて俺を責めてる。
findings.todokanai: After all, Setsuna's been running away from her own situation as well. She's condemning me exactly because she knows how it feels to do that.

findings.explanation: Setsuna weighs helping Koharu even against what she herself will lose. The translation changes that future cost of her choice into a past loss, erasing the active sacrifice occurring in this scene.
findings.japanese:
………それこそ、
自分が失うものと秤に掛けてでも。
findings.todokanai: …And that's even after she's placed what she's lost on the scale.

findings.highlight: I won't see her look upset again
findings.evidenceJa: もう、辛い目になんか遭わせない
findings.explanation: Haruki vows not to let Koharu undergo painful experiences again. The English only says he will not see her look upset, reducing prevention of harm to avoidance of a visible expression.
findings.japanese:
「もう潰させない。
もう、辛い目になんか遭わせない。
…俺が、なんとかしてみせる」
findings.todokanai: "I won't let her collapse anymore. I won't see her look upset again. …I'll do something about this."

findings.highlight: he just couldn't believe that you'd do all those absurd things
findings.evidenceJa: あんな理不尽なことされるコじゃない
findings.explanation: Takahiro said Koharu was not a girl who should have such unreasonable things done to her. The translation makes her the person who did absurd things, reversing victim and actor in his defense of her.
findings.japanese:
「本人、すごく言葉を選んでたけどね。
あんな理不尽なことされるコじゃないって、
自分の力不足が悔しかったって、嘆いてた」
findings.todokanai: "My brother really chose his words carefully, you know. He said he just couldn't believe that you'd do all those absurd things and expressed his frustration that he wasn't capable enough to help you."

findings.highlight: But I did do all those things
findings.evidenceJa: されるコですよ、わたし
findings.explanation: Koharu replies that she is a girl deserving to have those things done to her, continuing her self-punitive acceptance of victimization. The translation repeats the prior reversal and has her confess to perpetrating the acts instead.
findings.japanese:
「………されるコですよ、わたし。
あんなに力になってくれた小木曽まで裏切ったんだから」
findings.todokanai: "…But I did do all those things. I even betrayed Ogiso despite the fact that he stood up for me so much."
